text: HIP is a first-of-its-kind national-scale partnership between government and industry, characterized by its structured collaboration and data-sharing mandate. It explicitly links to public mitigation funding through the Disaster Ready Fund (DRF), aligning risk intelligence with capital deployment to maximize risk reduction. The partnership includes multi-agency and multi-scalar participation, with the involvement of major reinsurers like Munich Re and Swiss Re, embedding global catastrophe risk modeling expertise into its operations.
